model_output.verdict: A marketing executive with team, budget, and growth results attached, plus a few details worth sharpening.
write_up: A recruiter will see a marketing executive who leads a 45-person organization and manages a $25M annual budget, with results attached across demand generation and launches. The launch line gives the gains but not what you changed in the process.

The account-based marketing line is a good model: you built and executed the program, then named its pipeline contribution and win-rate gains. Add the launch process change and spell out your P&L responsibilities to make the leadership story more concrete.
